sysevent_email_action.message_html:
// Get fields from the triggering record
var name = fd_data.trigger.current.name;
var feedbackType = fd_data.trigger.current.feedback_type;
var serviceType = fd_data.trigger.current.service_type;
var assignedDept = fd_data.trigger.current.assigned_dept;
var assignedto = fd_data.trigger.current.assignedto;
var number = fd_data.trigger.current.number;
var status = fd_data.trigger.current.status;
var priority = fd_data.trigger.current.priority;

// Build the HTML email body
var body = `
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Ticket Update</title>
  </head>
  <body style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; background-color: #f6f7fb; margin:0; padding:20px;">
    <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" role="presentation">
      <tr>
        <td align="center">
          <table width="600" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" role="presentation" style="background:#ffffff; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); overflow:hidden;">
            <!-- Header -->
            <tr>
              <td style="padding:20px; background:#168AFF; color:#ffffff; text-align:left;">
                <h2 style="margin:0; font-size:20px;">Citizen Service Team</h2>
              </td>
            </tr>

            <!-- Body -->
            <tr>
              <td style="padding:24px; color:#333333;">
                <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">Hello <strong>${name}</strong>,</p>

                <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
                  We have received your <strong>${feedbackType}</strong> regarding <strong>${serviceType}</strong>.
                  The current status of your ticket is <strong>${status}</strong>.
                </p>

                <table cellpadding="8" cellspacing="0" width="100%" role="presentation" style="margin-top:16px; border-collapse:collapse;">
                  <tr>
                    <td style="background:#f2f5fb; border:1px solid #e6eefc; width:180px;"><strong>Ticket Number</strong></td>
                    <td style="border:1px solid #e6eefc;">${number}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td style="background:#f2f5fb; border:1px solid #e6eefc;"><strong>Current Status</strong></td>
                    <td style="border:1px solid #e6eefc;">${status}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td style="background:#f2f5fb; border:1px solid #e6eefc;"><strong>Priority</strong></td>
                    <td style="border:1px solid #e6eefc;">${priority}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td style="background:#f2f5fb; border:1px solid #e6eefc;"><strong>Department</strong></td>
                    <td style="border:1px solid #e6eefc;">${assignedDept}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td style="background:#f2f5fb; border:1px solid #e6eefc;"><strong>Assigned To</strong></td>
                    <td style="border:1px solid #e6eefc;">${assignedto}</td>
                  </tr>
                </table>

                <p style="margin:16px 0 0 0;">If you need to provide more information or want to discuss this ticket, reply to this email or visit the Citizen Service Portal.</p>

                <p style="margin:18px 0 0 0;">Thank you,<br><strong>Citizen Service Team</strong></p>
              </td>
            </tr>

            <!-- Footer -->
            <tr>
              <td style="padding:12px 20px; background:#f4f6fb; color:#6b7280; font-size:12px; text-align:center;">
                This is an automated message — please do not reply to this email.
              </td>
            </tr>
          </table>
        </td>
      </tr>
    </table>
  </body>
</html>
`;

return body;
sysevent_email_action.name: Application Status Email
